question: Estimate the market size for online insurance (health + term + motor + others) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Premium booked online or net new policies? Annual premium booked online.
Include both pure online (Policybazaar, Acko, Digit) and traditional insurer's online channel (HDFC ERGO online)? Yes.
Renewals included? Yes — total online premium.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: total Indian insurance premium → digital channel share by category.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total Indian insurance premium FY26 (life + non-life): ~₹14 lakh Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Health insurance premium: ~₹1 lakh Cr; online share ~25-30% = ₹28,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Other (travel, home, cyber, gadget): ~₹15,000 Cr; online share ~50% = ₹7,500 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total Indian insurance premium FY26 (life + non-life)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹85,000 Cr; online share ~35-40% = ₹32,000 Cr (renewal-heavy, easy online).

calculationFlow: Total Indian insurance premium FY26 (life + non-life): ~₹14 lakh Cr.
Life insurance premium: ~₹9 lakh Cr; online share ~5-7% = ₹50,000 Cr.
Health insurance premium: ~₹1 lakh Cr; online share ~25-30% = ₹28,000 Cr.
Motor insurance premium: ~₹85,000 Cr; online share ~35-40% = ₹32,000 Cr (renewal-heavy, easy online).
Other (travel, home, cyber, gadget): ~₹15,000 Cr; online share ~50% = ₹7,500 Cr.
